text: I enjoy trying new foods, visiting unfamiliar places, and exploring new ideas.
I prefer familiar routines and feel uneasy when things change unexpectedly.
I keep my living and working spaces organized and follow through on commitments.
I tend to procrastinate and sometimes leave tasks unfinished.
I am the kind of person who brings energy and enthusiasm to social gatherings.
I generally trust people and give them the benefit of the doubt.
I go out of my way to help others, even if it inconveniences me.
I get stressed or upset easily, even over small things.
I recover quickly from setbacks and don't dwell on negative emotions for long.
I appreciate art, music, and creative expression deeply.
